title: PHP emergency security release announced
content: The PHP security team announced two critical issues rated CVSS 4.0 9.2 and scheduled an emergency release for 21 October 2026 at 14:00 UTC. Exact affected and fixed versions were pending at this snapshot.

title: Critical vulnerabilities in PHP
content: CERT-EU identified CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in its 21 October advisory. Technical details and exact affected versions had not yet been published.
